title: Pick up where it stopped
story: Your 10 ns run (job 48100) hit its 20-minute time limit part way through. mdrun saved a checkpoint, md.cpt. Continue the run from the checkpoint in a new batch job with enough time, without starting over, and let it finish.

tasks.text: Continue md from its checkpoint in a batch job

hints: `gmx mdrun -deffnm md -cpi md.cpt` continues from the checkpoint and appends to the old files. Give the job a longer `--time`.

solution.text:
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=md
#SBATCH --partition=gpu
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:1
#SBATCH --mem=8G
#SBATCH --time=01:00:00
#SBATCH --output=md-%j.out

module load gromacs
gmx mdrun -deffnm md -nb gpu -cpi md.cpt
